messages:
anya: Hey team — I pushed a converted checkpoint to s3://redwood-onboard/packaged/nova13b_v2/ and started packaging. Noticed the TP layout looks wrong: converted with TP=8 but our serving config expects TP=4. Can someone sanity-check the shard map? 

matt: Can you paste the shard index file? also run `./scripts/validate_packaging.py --model nova13b_v2` — should catch layout mismatch. 

anya: here's the index extract:
```
shard_map: [0,1,2,3,4,5,6,7]
tp_axis: 0
shard_dims: [8,3072,3072]
```
But our `serve-config.yaml` expects `tp_axis: 1` and 4 shards per TP group. I converted with bf16 -> fp16 downcast, might have reshuffled dims. 

raj: heads up — tokenizer reorder during conversion changed ``[PAD]`` and ``[MASK]`` ids for this model in the safetensors header. Quick check:
```
python -c "from transformers import AutoTokenizer; t=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('s3://.../tokenizer/'); print(t.all_special_ids)"
```
If PAD != 0 we need remap or the model will hallucinate prompts with inline padding. 

sophie: packaging-lint flagged missing `model_metadata.json` in the safetensors bundle. We need `format_version`, `tokenizer_version`, `quantization` fields. I'll add a small CI step to fail early. 

deploy-bot: Conversion job 98765 completed — output bucket s3://redwood-onboard/packaged/nova13b_v2/ — logs: https://ci.redwood/invoke/98765 

infra-bot: CI: packaging-lint FAILED for 98765 — missing metadata.json — see logs. 

leo: I can take the shard-map repair. Two notes: 1) don't re-shard in-place, create remapped copy `*_remap.safetensors`. 2) when changing `tp_axis` check KV cache layout; mismatch will break streaming. 

matt: Also confirm quantization: if you downcast bf16->fp16 in a single op some layers may underflow. Recommend `--safe-downcast` flag (our script uses stochastic rounding). 

anya: thanks. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/models/pull/412 — includes remap script, metadata template, and tokenizer mapping. I'll attach a small test that loads first 2 tokens and runs forward to ensure output shape matches old model. 

leo: ping me once CI passes, I'll do a quick serve smoke on staging-dedicated (canary 5%) and run the tokenizer roundtrip test. 

sophie: I'll add lint gate and a note in the onboarding checklist about `tp_axis`. 

anya: Sounds good. Targeting merge by EOD. tagging @leo @matt for PR review. :party-parrot:
